title: Brookfield sets up to $5B to fund Bloom fuel cells for AI

sources.quote: In August 2025, Bloom Energy concluded a transaction with Brookfield Asset Management (“Brookfield”) for a prospective financing framework structure (the “Financing Structure”) of up to $5.0 billion over five years for future Bloom Energy fuel cell projects that meet certain investment criteria and contractual criteria or are otherwise approved by Brookfield.

explain: Brookfield agreed to provide up to $5 billion over five years to pay for Bloom Energy fuel-cell power systems at sites such as AI data centers, which Bloom then installs. Money flows only as qualifying projects are approved.
